people.name: Puneet Sharma
people.bio: Mr. Puneet Sharma brings over 26 years of experience across banking, financial services and strategy, including roles at Axis Bank Limited, Tata Capital Limited, Citibank, and The Boston Consulting Group. He is a Chartered Accountant and holds a Post Graduate Programme in Management.

career.role: Group Executive and Chief Financial Officer

people.name: V. Srinivasa Rangan
people.bio: Aged 66, he is the Executive Director of the Bank. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Commerce and is an Associate of the ICAI. He is an expert in finance, accountancy, audit, economics, and corporate governance.

education.school: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)

people.name: V. N. Srivatsan
people.bio: Mr. V. N. Srivatsan has approximately 34 years of professional experience, including 25 years in the BFSI sector and 10 years in Compliance and Regulatory Inspection. He previously served as Head – Compliance at ICICI Bank Limited.

career.role: Head – Compliance: Overseas Banking and Subsidiaries & Data Privacy Officer
